description: Import labeling tasks into an Open Label project from a manifest (CSV, JSON array, or JSON Lines rows — each row becomes a task). The same policy allowlist, row_data caps, async ingest routing, and idempotency keys as the UI import apply. Requires open-label:write scope.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse-safe import key: repeating it returns the original dataset.

manifestText.description: Manifest rows as CSV, a JSON array, or JSON Lines (up to 50,000 rows).

name.description: Dataset name (defaults to a timestamped import).

name: open_label_import_data
